segments.name: Journeys Group
segments.description: Retail footwear chain and e-commerce operations selling branded footwear, apparel and accessories to youth and children consumers.
segments.evidence: Journeys Group, comprised of the Journeys ® , Journeys Kidz ® and Little Burgundy ® retail footwear chains and e-commerce operations

segments.name: Schuh Group
segments.description: Retail footwear chain and e-commerce operations selling branded footwear primarily in the United Kingdom and Republic of Ireland.
segments.evidence: Schuh Group, comprised of the Schuh retail footwear chain and e-commerce operations

segments.name: Johnston & Murphy Group
segments.description: Retail operations, e-commerce and wholesale distribution of branded footwear, apparel and accessories to consumers and retail accounts.
segments.evidence: Johnston & Murphy Group, comprised of Johnston & Murphy ® retail operations, e-commerce operations and wholesale distribution of products under the Johnston & Murphy ® brand

segments.name: Genesco Brands Group
segments.description: Licensed branded footwear wholesaler sourcing, designing, marketing and distributing footwear under licensed brands to retail accounts.
segments.evidence: Genesco Brands Group, comprised of the licensed Dockers ® ("Dockers") and Levi's ® ("Levi's") brands, as well as other brands we license for footwear

revenueModel.text: Consumers and wholesale retail accounts purchase branded footwear, apparel and accessories through retail stores, e-commerce websites and wholesale distribution channels.
revenueModel.evidence: We also source, design, market and distribute footwear, apparel and accessories at wholesale, primarily under our Johnston & Murphy brand, the licensed Dockers ® brand, the licensed Levi's ® brand and other brands that we license for footwear to over 900 retail accounts in the United States

changes.text: In Fiscal 2026, the company exited its Levi's license business which was set to expire in May 2026.
changes.evidence: Our license with Levi's expires in May 2026 and we are in the process of exiting that business.

changes.text: In Fiscal 2026, the company signed a multi-year licensing agreement with Kontoor Brands to design, source, market and distribute footwear under the Wrangler brand.
changes.evidence: During the second quarter of Fiscal 2026, we signed a multi-year licensing agreement with Kontoor Brands, Inc. ("Kontoor") to design, source market and distribute men's, women's and children's footwear under the Wrangler ® brand ("Wrangler").

changes.text: In Fiscal 2026, the company announced formation of the Journeys Global Retail Group uniting Journeys, Schuh and Little Burgundy retail banners.
changes.evidence: During the third quarter of Fiscal 2026, we announced the formation of the Journeys Global Retail Group which unites Journeys, Schuh and Little Burgundy.
